tagline: Adds no review finding for the offline secret-blast-radius report invocations, while the --osv lookup and report-file writes stay reviewed.
summary: secret-blast-radius lists which credentials a malicious npm install could reach on a machine or CI runner and prints an ordered rotation plan. It never prints secret values and changes nothing. This extension adds no review finding for its offline report invocations, and Guard's baseline review for external extensions still applies; the opt-in --osv lookup (sends lockfile package names and versions to api.osv.dev) and --sarif-file/--runbook-file writes stay under review.
limitations: Only the listed offline report invocations get no extension finding; any other form, including a bare run with project directories, keeps review.
The extension classifies invocations; it does not verify the installed package or its findings.
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
